Stepan Surfactant Chemistry

The molecules are embedded with ETKDG and relaxed with MMFF94 (RDKit); the most extended conformer within 12 kcal/mol of the lowest is shown. The atomistic micelles and bilayers (Model) are geometric: relaxed monomers placed tail-in on a sphere, a capsule or two sheets, with the number of monomers taken from the packing model. The Dynamics view is a coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulation (OpenMM, explicit water, a MARTINI-style bead model with my own bead assignment, 20 fs steps, 310 K) that started from random chains, so every aggregate in it formed during the run; it is a model, not a measurement. The notebooks recompute every number; to run them, follow the instructions in the README. 3D view: 3Dmol.js (BSD-3-Clause).
